subtitle: Cross-reading of September 18, 2026, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT (21:59 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 151.46M. All five tracked contracts received a new price in this round: winner, runner-up in the first round, third place in the first round, impeachment at the Supreme Court and Senate. On the polling side, the two national polls entering are Datafolha and Futura/100% Cidades, both released on Sep 17 after that day's capture, and they disagree on the sign of the runoff.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 42.50% (vol USD 11.36M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, down 2.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 17. POLLS: in the first round 39% at Datafolha and 38.3% at Futura; in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro 46% at Datafolha and 43.7% at Futura.
fortes: Leads the first round in both national polls of Sep 17, 39% to 36% at Datafolha and 38.3% to 37.7% at Futura/100% Cidades, and in both the distance fits inside two margins.
At Datafolha he wins the runoff 46% to 44%, and it is the firm's third straight wave with exactly these numbers, meaning the pair has not moved inside it since Sep 11.
In the runner-up contract for the first round he rises 6.70pp, to 29.35%, his largest move in any book this round.
fracos: Falls 2.00pp in the winner contract, to 42.50%, and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro widens from 10.20pp to 14.00pp with both sides moving.
Stands 25.00pp below the top of his series, 67.50% on Aug 16, in a series that begins on Apr 14.
At Futura/100% Cidades he loses the runoff 48.1% to 43.7%, a distance of 4.4 points that falls outside two margins of 2.2.
candidates.analise: The round is one of a falling price and two polls that disagree on the sign of the runoff. In the winner contract he falls 2.00pp, to 42.50% (vol USD 11.36M accumulated), and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro widens from 10.20pp to 14.00pp, now with both sides moving, not just the opponent. In the runner-up contract for the first round the move is the reverse and larger: he rises 6.70pp, to 29.35%, because whoever becomes less likely to win becomes more likely to finish second. The two national polls released on Sep 17 after that day's capture put him ahead in the first round and disagree on the runoff: Datafolha, in person, gives 46% to 44% for him, inside the margins; Futura/100% Cidades, by phone, gives 43.7% to 48.1% against him, outside two margins. That is 6.4 points of difference between the firms on the same pair. On government assessment the two also part ways, 48% approval at Datafolha against 44.1% at Futura.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 56.50% (vol USD 11.02M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, up 1.80pp against the price confirmed on Sep 17. POLLS: in the first round 36% at Datafolha and 37.7% at Futura; in the runoff against Lula 44% at Datafolha and 48.1% at Futura.
fortes: Reaches 56.50% in the winner contract and stands 0.10pp above the highest value of his entire recorded series, which until today had never passed that level in a series that begins on Apr 14.
At Futura/100% Cidades he wins the runoff 48.1% to 43.7%, outside two margins of 2.2, and in the first round he closes on Lula 37.7% to 38.3%.
At Datafolha he rises from 35% to 36% in the first round and comes to stand 3 points from Lula, a distance that fits inside two margins of 2.0.
fracos: In the runner-up contract for the first round he falls 7.00pp, to 69.50%, the largest change of any contract in this round.
At Datafolha he loses the runoff 44% to 46% and his rejection rises from 46% to 47%, tied with Lula's.
At Futura/100% Cidades his rejection is 45.3%, the second highest figure in the poll, behind only Lula's.
candidates.analise: The round puts his price above the highest value ever recorded in the series and, at the same time, shows the polls disagreeing about him. In the winner contract he rises 1.80pp, to 56.50% (vol USD 11.02M accumulated), and the gap to Lula widens from 10.20pp to 14.00pp. In the runner-up contract for the first round he falls 7.00pp, to 69.50%, and the two things are the same fact seen from two angles: the book came to treat him less as a likely runner-up and more as a likely winner. In the polls the picture is not single. Futura/100% Cidades, by phone and with field Sep 11 to 15, has him winning the runoff 48.1% to 43.7%, outside two margins. Datafolha, in person and with field Sep 15 to 16, has him losing 44% to 46%, inside the margins and for the third straight wave with the same pair. The panel shows the distance between the two and does not pick one of them.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.15% in the winner contract and 41.00% (vol USD 226 thousand accumulated) in the third-place contract for the first round, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT. POLLS: 6% in the first round at Datafolha and 6.5% at Futura.
fortes: He is third in both national polls of Sep 17, 6% at Datafolha and 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, ahead of Renan Santos in both.
At Datafolha his rejection is 9%, the lowest among the six names with 2% or more of voting intention.
fracos: Falls 1.90pp in the third-place contract for the first round, to 41.00%, and stands 8.00pp behind Renan Santos, who yesterday was 1.10pp ahead of him.
In the winner contract he stands at 0.15%, below the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series, 0.20% on Sep 17.
The polls and the book disagree on the order of the third way: both firms put him ahead of Renan Santos, and the third-place contract pays more on Renan.
candidates.analise: His case is the most direct cross of this round, and it does not reconcile. In the two national polls of Sep 17 he is the third most voted, with 6% at Datafolha and 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, ahead of Renan Santos in both. In the third-place contract for the first round the opposite happens: he falls 1.90pp, to 41.00%, and comes to stand 8.00pp behind Renan Santos, when on Sep 17 he was 1.10pp ahead of him. In the winner contract he stands at 0.15%, below the lowest value ever recorded in his series. The panel records that the two instruments disagree on the order, without claiming which one will prove right.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.95% (vol USD 13.69M accumulated) in the winner contract and 49.00% (vol USD 347 thousand accumulated) in the third-place contract for the first round, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT. POLLS: 3% in the first round at Datafolha and 3.4% at Futura.
fortes: Rises 5.00pp in the third-place contract for the first round, to 49.00%, and opens 8.00pp over Augusto Cury, who yesterday was 1.10pp away.
His is the contract with the largest accumulated volume in the runner-up and third-place books for the first round, USD 1.33M and USD 347 thousand.
He filed a petition at the Superior Electoral Court against the Bolsa Família increase on Sep 17, and the rapporteur drawn was André Mendonça.
fracos: In the winner contract he falls 0.20pp, to 0.95%, and stands 0.05pp below the lowest value of his entire recorded series, which until today had never gone below that level.
In the two national polls of Sep 17 he stands behind Augusto Cury, 3% to 6% at Datafolha and 3.4% to 6.5% at Futura/100% Cidades.
At Datafolha his rejection is 15%, the third highest in the poll, behind only Lula's and Flávio Bolsonaro's.
candidates.analise: His two contracts moved in opposite directions in the same reading, and that is no contradiction: one measures finishing third in the first round and the other measures winning the election. In the third-place one he rises 5.00pp, to 49.00%, takes a comfortable lead over Augusto Cury and comes to hold the largest accumulated volume in that book. In the winner one he falls 0.20pp, to 0.95%, below the lowest value ever recorded in his series. The polls do not follow the rise in third place: Datafolha gives him 3% and Futura/100% Cidades 3.4%, behind Cury in both. Outside the ballot, on Sep 17 he filed a petition at the Superior Electoral Court against the Bolsa Família increase, after a first filing, by another plaintiff, had been rejected for lack of standing.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado 0.05% and 10.50% in the third-place contract, Romeu Zema 0.15% and Fernando Haddad 0.05%, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT. POLLS: Caiado 4% at Datafolha and 4.5% at Futura; Zema 2% and 1.0%.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the front-runner group, with prices from the confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT and polls from Datafolha and Futura/100% Cidades of Sep 17.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading and below the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series, 0.10% on Sep 17. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he falls 2.00pp, to 10.50%, in a book of USD 137 thousand. He has 4% in the first round at Datafolha and 4.5% at Futura/100% Cidades.
caiado.fortes: He is fourth in both national polls of Sep 17, with 4% at Datafolha and 4.5% at Futura/100% Cidades, and keeps third position in the third-place book for the first round.
caiado.fracos: He falls 2.00pp in the third-place contract for the first round and, in the winner contract, stands below the lowest value ever recorded in his series. Neither firm tests him in a runoff pair in this round.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, at the floor of the book. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the two national polls of Sep 17 do not test him in a presidential first-round scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no movement to explain, and the top of his series in the winner contract is 7.60%, on May 26, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the first round by the two national polls of Sep 17, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, still below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the THIRD-PLACE contract for the first round he falls 0.50pp, to 0.35%. He has 2% in the first round at Datafolha and 1.0% at Futura/100% Cidades.
zema.fortes: He moves off the floor of his series in the winner contract, 0.10% on Sep 17, even though the value still stands below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to treat a thin price as noise.
zema.fracos: He falls 0.50pp in the third-place contract for the first round and neither of the two national polls of Sep 17 tests him in a runoff pair. The top of his series in the winner contract is 12.00%, on May 13.

candidates.analise: The three remain at the floor of the winner contract, and it is in the third-place contract for the first round that there is a price with movement. Ronaldo Caiado falls 2.00pp there, to 10.50%, and keeps third position in that book, behind Renan Santos and Augusto Cury. Romeu Zema falls 0.50pp, to 0.35%. In the two national polls of Sep 17, Caiado has 4% and 4.5% and Zema has 2% and 1.0%, and neither of them is tested in a runoff pair by the two firms. Fernando Haddad does not appear in any prompted first-round scenario and remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, with the top of his series at 7.60%, on May 26.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado keeps third place in the third-place contract for the first round, with 10.50% and USD 137 thousand accumulated.
At Datafolha, Ronaldo Caiado has 4% in the first round and a rejection of 13%, below Renan Santos's and Romeu Zema's.
fracos: Ronaldo Caiado falls 2.00pp in the third-place contract, to 10.50%, and in the winner contract he stands at 0.05%, below the lowest value in the recorded readings of his series, 0.10% on Sep 17.
Romeu Zema falls 0.50pp in the third-place contract, to 0.35%, and has 2% at Datafolha and 1.0% at Futura/100% Cidades.
Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract and is not tested in the first round by either of the two national polls of Sep 17.

At Futura/100% Cidades of the same day (field Sep 11 to 15, phone, 2,000 interviews, margin of 2.2pp) he has 38.3% in the first round and loses the runoff 43.7% to 48.1%.

That is 3.9 points of difference on approval between two firms that published on the same day, and the panel does not read them as a series.

cruzamento: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FROM 10.20pp TO 14.00pp WITH BOTH SIDES MOVING: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 54.70% to 56.50% (vol USD 11.02M), above the highest value in the recorded readings of his series, and Lula fell from 44.50% to 42.50% (vol USD 11.36M), confirmed reading of Sep 18, 18:59 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 17. ⚖️ THE SAME MOVE SHOWS UP LARGER AND INVERTED IN THE RUNNER-UP CONTRACT FOR THE FIRST ROUND, where Flávio Bolsonaro falls 7.00pp, to 69.50%, and Lula rises 6.70pp, to 29.35%: the two books measure the same thing from opposite sides, and the runner-up book moved almost four times more. 🔴 THE TWO NATIONAL POLLS OF Sep 17 ENTERING THIS ROUND DISAGREE ON THE SIGN OF THE RUNOFF. Datafolha, in person, field Sep 15 to 16, margin of 2.0pp, gives Lula 46% to 44% and repeats the pair for the third straight wave. Futura/100% Cidades, by phone, field Sep 11 to 15, margin of 2.2pp, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 48.1% to 43.7%. That is 6.4 points of distance on the same pair, with the sign reversed, and both came out on the same day. In the first round they agree: Lula ahead by 3 points and by 0.6 point, both distances inside two margins. 🥉 IN THE THIRD WAY THE BOOK AND THE BALLOT INVERT: in the third-place contract for the first round Renan Santos rises 5.00pp, to 49.00%, and Augusto Cury falls 1.90pp, to 41.00%, while both polls put Cury ahead of Renan, 6% to 3% and 6.5% to 3.4%. 🏛️ The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 falls 0.45pp, to 4.60%, on a day when the Supreme Court decided nothing on the two investigation requests and on which Daniel Vorcaro's defence asked for his pretrial detention to be revoked. The panel measures both universes and does not say which one will prove right.
